abstract: We establish four exact theorems and symbolic verification algorithms for Hodge-character lattices and complete-intersection cycles on composite-degree Fermat varieties $X_d^n \subset \mathbb{P}^{n+1}$ as partial contributions toward Fermat Hodge classes. First, in the torsion-free reduced character lattice $F_d = (\bigoplus_{a=1}^{d-1} \mathbb{Z} e_a)/\widetilde{D}_d \simeq \mathbb{Z}^{m_d}$ ($m_d = \lfloor(d-1)/2\rfloor$), Aoki's formal Parry-Shioda weight-kernel $\mathcal{B}_d := \ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(W_d) \subset F_d$ is saturated of rank $r_d = m_d - \varphi(d)/2$ via a conductor-wise projection onto non-unit columns $a = d/f$. For $18$ two-factor degrees $d \in \{12, 15, \dots, 95\}$ and four three-factor degrees $d \in \{60, 84, 105, 140\}$, the Smith Normal Form of $M_{S_d}$ over $\mathbb{Z}$ has non-zero factors $(1^{r_d - 1}, 2)$ (resp. $(1^{r_d - 3}, 2, 2, 2)$), certifying $\rho_d(B_d) = \mathcal{B}_d$ and yielding a canonical quotient map $\bar{\pi}_d : \mathcal{B}_d \to \mathcal{B}_d/\rho_d(S_d)$. Across $d \in \{35, 44, 51, 52, 68\}$, $100\%$ of $\mathfrak{B}_d^2 \cup \mathfrak{B}_d^4$ has $\bar{\pi}_d(\rho_d(\alpha)) = 0$ and lies integrally in $D_d + \mathrm{Std}_{p_{\min}}$, and we prove an Inductive Splitting Parity Lemma in $F_{52}$. Second, we prove that $\mathcal{B}_{4p}^{\mathrm{std}}$ and $\mathcal{B}_{p_1 p_2}^{\mathrm{std}}$ are free $\mathbb{Z}$-bases of $\rho_d(S_d)$ with minimal $\ell_1$-norms $\ell_{2, 4p}(\xi_{4p}) = 2\lfloor(p+1)/4\rfloor + N_{\mathrm{obs}}(2, p)$ and $\ell_{2, p_1 p_2}(\xi_{p_1 p_2}) = (p_1-1)(p_2-1)/4 + N_{\mathrm{obs}}(p_2, p_1) + N_{\mathrm{obs}}(p_1, p_2)$, plus a $2$-standard collapse law $d \to 2d$ and a Unit-Divisibility Barrier at $d = 4p$. Third, on $X_{2m}^4$, we prove a Kronecker Catalecticant Factorization Theorem and construct orthogonal character idempotents realizing the $6$-level Catalecticant staircase $L_1(m) > \dots > L_6(m)$ (global minimum $40$ on $X_6^4$ and $96$ on $X_8^4$). Fourth, we prove the all-$p$ Two-Term Mixed Quartic Binomial Obstruction, the Universal $(2p, 4)$ and $(p, q)$ Identities, the Discriminant-Zero $3$-variable $2$-product syzygy ($3r^4 = 1$), the Quaternary Counting Law, and the $\mathcal{A}_p(k_0) \oplus \mathcal{B}_p(k_1)$ Jacobian Determinant Factorization across $d \in \{12, 20, 28, 44, 52\}$.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: Version 2 resolves all referee notes from the Version 1 acceptance report (ragjcnfQbRyLpwih) and the revision reports (jiBjXzmfKc7dYoWH, To4LKeUHSkRxTku0, MchEwv2ts1f7N4sp) as well as peer-review refinements from u/cm_symmetry_scout (r/hodge_conjecture/post/9 and post/4) and extends Theorem 1 and Theorem 4 with new symbolic certificates (exp35, exp36): (1) In Theorem 1(a) and verify_conductor_wise_row_rank, replaced the unit-sum sentence for imprimitive odd Dirichlet characters chi modulo d (of conductor f | d) by the exact conductor-wise projection onto the non-unit column a = d/f of W_d, proving sum_{u in U_d} bar{chi}(u) c_{d/f}(u) = 2d(phi(d)/phi(f)) B_{1, bar{chi}_f} != 0 (e.g. at d = 21, unit columns have rank 5 < 6 while column a = 7 has projection -84 != 0 and restores rank(W_21) = 6); (2) In Theorem 1(a), Table 1, and verify_three_factor_4p1p2_holonomy_cube, added the even three-factor Fermat family d = 4 p_1 p_2 at d in {60, 84, 140} alongside d = 105, certifying r_{4 p_1 p_2} = p_1 p_2 + p_1 + p_2 - 2, SNF invariant factors (1^{r_d - 3}, 2, 2, 2), and executing an exhaustive lower-bound search directly inside verify_three_factor_4p1p2_holonomy_cube that certifies the exact coset minimum lengths (3,3,3,3,4,4,6) at d=60, (3,3,4,5,6,6,7) at d=84, and (3,4,6) on {(0,1,0),(1,0,0),(0,1,1)} at d=140 alongside 3-generator representative upper bounds; (3) In Section 4, listed the complete Catalecticant rank sets from enumerate_exceptional_fourfold_characters on X_6^4 and X_8^4 and clarified the distinction between Q(zeta_{2m})-coefficient group-ring projections and normalized E_m-coefficient cycles isolating m_e and m_e + m_{bar{e}}; (4) In Theorem 4(a) and Remark 5.1, proved the all-p Two-Term Mixed Quartic Binomial Single-Square Obstruction (for P_4 = c_m x_0^m x_3^{4-m} + c_4 x_0^4 with 1 <= m <= 3 and prime p >= 5, x_0^{4p} + x_3^{4p} - P_4^p = Q_{2p}^2 iff c_m c_4 = 0 with c_4^p = 1 or m=2, c_2^p = +-2, plus a p=5 Grobner [1] certificate for 4-term quartics with c_0 = 0), presented the even-exponent parity-orthogonality law to xi_{4p}^{min}, and proved the positive W-degree split obstruction via Mason-Stothers; and (5) In Theorem 4(b)-(c) and supplement.zip, established the Universal (p, q) Cross-Term Factorization and its canonical degree-(2d-3) Jacobian 3-form Omega_{1,2}^{(q,p)} (withdrawing the unverified dual-wedge clause), the Quadratic Reciprocity Quaternary Counting Law, the actual 4x4 Jacobian determinant factorization D_B generating B_p(k_1) with exact mod-4 residues, and bundled all hodge_loci_engine modules in supplement.zip.
title: Smith Normal Form Parity Functionals, Symmetric Two-Tower $q$-Adic Cycle Holonomy, and the Automorphic Kronecker Catalecticant Rank-Drop Staircase on Fermat Varieties
